An office move needs more than transportation.

A successful office relocation depends on preparation: inventory, access, elevator timing, loading area rules, labeling, fragile equipment, furniture layout, and communication with building management.

Atlantic Star Relocations approaches office moving with a practical plan so every stage is easier to manage — from the first walkthrough to final placement at the new location.

Common office moving details we review

  • Office size, inventory, and number of workstations
  • Desks, chairs, conference tables, cabinets, and shelving
  • Computers, monitors, printers, copiers, and electronics
  • Elevator reservations, loading dock rules, and parking access
  • COI/building requirements when requested by the building
  • Packing, labeling, file organization, and placement plan

Office Moving FAQ

Answers to common questions about office moving, commercial relocation, packing, equipment handling, and building logistics.

Do you provide office moving services?

Yes. Atlantic Star Relocations provides office moving and commercial relocation support for businesses across Westchester, NYC, New Jersey, and Connecticut.

Can you move desks, chairs, cabinets, and conference tables?

Yes. We handle office furniture including desks, office chairs, conference tables, filing cabinets, shelving, reception furniture, and workstations.

Can you help pack office items?

Yes. We can assist with office packing, file boxes, supplies, equipment packing, labeling, and organized destination placement.

Do you handle computers and office electronics?

We can carefully handle monitors, computers, printers, copiers, cables, and office electronics. Sensitive IT disconnection or reconnection should be handled by the client’s IT provider when required.

How do you minimize business downtime during an office move?

Office moves are planned with structured scheduling, labeled inventory, building coordination, and a clear sequence of work to reduce operational disruption.

Do you coordinate elevator or loading dock access?

We review elevator windows, loading dock rules, parking conditions, building access, and required timing before move day.

Can you disassemble and reassemble office furniture?

Yes. We can assist with many desks, conference tables, shelving units, and selected modular furniture. Complex systems may require specialized vendor support.

How do I get an office moving quote?

Send your office size, inventory list, pickup and delivery addresses, access details, and preferred move date through the form below or call (929) 249-2727.
